html:
Explore Vung Tau with Vietlook Travel, relax at beautiful beaches, visit spiritual landmarks, and enjoy panoramic views of the city on this full day tour.

TOUR OVERVIEW

Duration: 1 day | Departure: 7:00 – 7:30 to 18:00 | Transportation: Bus

Morning (07:20 AM): Pick up from your hotel and depart for Vung Tau (approximately 3 hours driving).

THUY VAN BEACH (BAI SAU): On arrival, enjoy leisure time at Thuy Van Beach (Back Beach) – one of the most beautiful beaches in Vietnam, stretching almost 10 km with fine sand and gentle waves. Take a swim or simply relax and enjoy the sea breeze.

Noon: Enjoy authentic Vietnamese lunch at a local restaurant.

Afternoon:

  • JESUS CHRIST STATUE: Visit this miniature version of Brazil’s Cristo Redentor. Climb inside and admire the entire Bai Sau beach area and part of Vung Tau city from the statue’s arms.

  • DINH THANG TAM (WHALE TEMPLE): Discover the spiritual and cultural significance of Whale Temple, a sacred place for local fishermen. Visitors come here to pray for safety, peace, and prosperity.

  • BACH DINH (White Palace): Explore this ancient French-style villa, magnificently built on the mountainside of Vung Tau.

  • NGHINH PHONG CAPE: Visit one of the top must-see spots in Vung Tau, known for its “front sea, back mountain” scenery. A popular place for photos and sightseeing.

Please note: Drop-off time may vary due to traffic or weather conditions, so the tour may end later than expected.

Price/pax: 40$

TOUR INCLUDES:

  • Transportation: Air-conditioned tourist bus with soft seats

  • Meals: 1 main meal (lunch)

  • Guide: Vietnamese-English speaking tour guide

  • Sightseeing: Entrance fees to attractions listed in the program

  • Service: 1 bottle of mineral water per person

TOUR EXCLUDES:

  • Personal expenses outside the program

  • VAT 10% (upon request)

CHILDREN POLICY:

  • Under 5 years old: Free, parents take care of the child themselves (two adults accompany 1 child; the 2nd child pays 75% of tour price)

  • 5–9 years old: 75% of ticket price (includes meal, entrance fees, private seat)

  • 10 years and above: Charged as adult ticket price

Note: 1 adult + 1 child booking counts as 2 adults for the tour.
